questions.explanation: 前文提到烹饪一直是我的一个小乐趣（small enjoyment），因此十年前我在从头制作美食中找到了巨大的“快乐（joy）”。易错点：A项loss（失落）与文意相反；D项trouble（麻烦）不符合享受烹饪的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(loss)：语境句：The company suffered a great loss last year. 固定搭配：a loss of, at a loss
B(joy)：语境句：She wept for joy when she heard the good news. 固定搭配：find joy in, to one's joy
C(courage)：语境句：It takes courage to stand up for what you believe in. 固定搭配：muster courage, lose courage
D(trouble)：语境句：He got into trouble for being late again. 固定搭配：have trouble doing, in trouble

questions.explanation: 由后文“including a few unfortunate cuts（包括几次不幸的割伤）”可知，这里指的是发生了一系列“意外事故（accidents）”。
questions.supplement:
A(choices)：语境句：We have a wide range of choices for breakfast. 固定搭配：make a choice, have no choice but to
B(treatments)：语境句：The hospital provides various treatments for patients. 固定搭配：medical treatment, undergo treatment
C(accidents)：语境句：He was badly injured in a car accident. 固定搭配：by accident, traffic accident
D(questions)：语境句：Feel free to ask questions if you are confused. 固定搭配：ask a question, out of the question

questions.explanation: 因为经历了切到手等一系列意外，所以作者对做饭变得“犹豫、害怕（hesitant）”。易错点：B项excited（兴奋）和D项ready（准备好）与受伤后的心理不符。
questions.supplement:
A(hesitant)：语境句：She was hesitant to accept the job offer in a new city. 固定搭配：be hesitant to do, hesitant about
B(excited)：语境句：The kids were excited about the upcoming field trip. 固定搭配：be excited about, get excited
C(curious)：语境句：Children are naturally curious about the world around them. 固定搭配：be curious about, out of curiosity
D(ready)：语境句：Are you ready to order your meal? 固定搭配：be ready for, get ready to

questions.explanation: 后文提到“relying more on my husband to cook or takeout（更多地依靠丈夫做饭或点外卖）”，说明作者渐渐远离了“做饭（cooking）”。
questions.supplement:
A(cleaning)：语境句：She spends her weekends cleaning the house. 固定搭配：do the cleaning, dry cleaning
B(cooking)：语境句：My mother's cooking is always the best. 固定搭配：do the cooking, home cooking
C(hospitals)：语境句：Many hospitals are under severe pressure during the flu season. 固定搭配：go to hospital, in hospital
D(restaurants)：语境句：We decided to eat out at a local restaurant. 固定搭配：book a restaurant, fast-food restaurant

questions.explanation: 句首有However表转折，说明作者现在决定“重新发现（rediscover）”对烹饪的热爱。易错点：C项forget（忘记）逻辑相反；A项convey（传达）不符合自我内心的转变。
questions.supplement:
A(convey)：语境句：Words cannot convey how grateful I am for your help. 固定搭配：convey information, convey one's feelings
B(test)：语境句：The teacher will test the students on their vocabulary. 固定搭配：take a test, stand the test of time
C(forget)：语境句：Don't forget to lock the door when you leave. 固定搭配：forget about, forget to do
D(rediscover)：语境句：He traveled to the countryside to rediscover his inner peace. 固定搭配：rediscover oneself, rediscover the joy of

questions.explanation: 前文提到了手上的伤（cuts），所以重回厨房时会害怕再次“弄伤（injuring）”自己。
questions.supplement:
A(injuring)：语境句：He missed the match for fear of injuring his ankle again. 固定搭配：injure oneself, badly injured
B(excusing)：语境句：There is no excusing such rude behavior. 固定搭配：excuse sb for doing, make an excuse
C(blaming)：语境句：She is always blaming others for her own mistakes. 固定搭配：blame sb for sth, take the blame
D(changing)：语境句：The weather here is constantly changing. 固定搭配：change one's mind, changing room

questions.explanation: “cost of living”是固定表达，意为“生活成本”。随着生活成本的不断上升，只依赖餐馆不再具有可持续性。
questions.supplement:
A(level)：语境句：The water level in the river rose dangerously high. 固定搭配：sea level, high level
B(value)：语境句：This ancient coin is of great historic value. 固定搭配：core value, of great value
C(quality)：语境句：We aim to provide high quality products to our customers. 固定搭配：high quality, quality of life
D(cost)：语境句：The cost of living in big cities is quite high. 固定搭配：cost of living, at all costs

questions.explanation: 尽管内心有恐惧，但基于生活成本的现实，作者带着“决心（determination）”重新走进了厨房。
questions.supplement:
A(energy)：语境句：Running a marathon requires a lot of energy. 固定搭配：save energy, full of energy
B(dream)：语境句：Her dream is to become a famous singer. 固定搭配：achieve a dream, dream of doing
C(determination)：语境句：He overcame his disability with sheer determination. 固定搭配：with determination, strong determination
D(pleasure)：语境句：It is a great pleasure to work with you. 固定搭配：with pleasure, my pleasure

questions.explanation: 后文提到了具体的菜品红酒炖牛肉（Beef Bourguignon），这是一份“食谱（recipe）”。
questions.supplement:
A(gift)：语境句：She has a special gift for learning languages quickly. 固定搭配：birthday gift, have a gift for
B(recipe)：语境句：My grandma passed down this secret recipe to me. 固定搭配：secret recipe, a recipe for disaster
C(idea)：语境句：It is a good idea to bring an umbrella just in case. 固定搭配：have no idea, come up with an idea
D(advertisement)：语境句：I saw an advertisement for a new smartphone on TV. 固定搭配：place an advertisement, job advertisement

questions.explanation: 虽然早就爱上了做饭，但以前从未“尝试（attempted）”过这道经典的法国菜。
questions.supplement:
A(sold)：语境句：The tickets for the concert were completely sold out. 固定搭配：sell out, best-selling
B(mentioned)：语境句：He mentioned that he would be late for the meeting. 固定搭配：not to mention, as mentioned above
C(attempted)：语境句：He attempted to swim across the English Channel. 固定搭配：attempt to do, make an attempt
D(accepted)：语境句：She finally accepted his apology and forgave him. 固定搭配：accept an offer, widely accepted

questions.explanation: “a labor of love”是英语常见习语，指“心甘情愿做的事（尤指不计报酬、出于爱好而做的艰苦工作）”。制作这道菜需要大量时间精力，但出于热爱所以值得。
questions.supplement:
A(labor)：语境句：Restoring this antique car was truly a labor of love. 固定搭配：manual labor, a labor of love
B(rule)：语境句：You must follow the rules of the game. 固定搭配：break the rule, as a rule
C(mark)：语境句：The incident left a permanent mark on his memory. 固定搭配：leave a mark, hit the mark
D(promise)：语境句：She made a promise to visit her grandparents every week. 固定搭配：keep a promise, make a promise

questions.explanation: 做这道菜需要时间、细节上的关注以及“耐心（patience）”。
questions.supplement:
A(space)：语境句：We need more storage space in the kitchen. 固定搭配：outer space, empty space
B(belief)：语境句：It is her firm belief that hard work pays off. 固定搭配：beyond belief, hold a belief
C(caution)：语境句：You should exercise caution when crossing the busy street. 固定搭配：with caution, exercise caution
D(patience)：语境句：Teaching young children requires a great deal of patience. 固定搭配：have patience with, lose patience

questions.explanation: 从给牛肉调味到与红酒混合，烹饪过程中的每一个“步骤（step）”都是对风味与技巧的庆祝。
questions.supplement:
A(dish)：语境句：This vegetarian dish is made with fresh ingredients. 固定搭配：wash the dishes, a popular dish
B(event)：语境句：The Olympic Games is a major international sporting event. 固定搭配：in the event of, at all events
C(step)：语境句：Taking this course is the first step towards your career. 固定搭配：step by step, take steps
D(secret)：语境句：She kept her plans a secret from her family. 固定搭配：keep a secret, in secret

questions.explanation: 第一次成功做出这样复杂的菜，给作者带来了一种“成就感（sense of accomplishment）”。
questions.supplement:
A(relief)：语境句：It was a great relief to know that everyone was safe. 固定搭配：sigh of relief, to one's relief
B(accomplishment)：语境句：Winning the championship gave him a huge sense of accomplishment. 固定搭配：sense of accomplishment, remarkable accomplishment
C(warmth)：语境句：He felt the warmth of the sun on his face. 固定搭配：feel the warmth, provide warmth
D(responsibility)：语境句：It is your responsibility to complete the task on time. 固定搭配：take responsibility for, sense of responsibility

questions.explanation: 做饭不一定非得是某种“负担（burden）”，它可以是一种自我表达的方式。与文章开头所逃避做饭的负面情绪形成对比呼应。
questions.supplement:
A(burden)：语境句：The heavy debt became a huge burden on the poor family. 固定搭配：a heavy burden, shoulder the burden
B(surprise)：语境句：His sudden resignation took everyone by surprise. 固定搭配：to one's surprise, take sb by surprise
C(regret)：语境句：I have no regrets about the choices I have made. 固定搭配：express regret, with regret
D(danger)：语境句：The abandoned building is in danger of collapsing. 固定搭配：in danger, out of danger

vocab_pack.definition_en: the state or process of taking pleasure in something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作可数名词，a small enjoyment 表示「一个小小的乐趣」；句中用单数形式，前有冠词 a。
vocab_pack.example_en: Reading brings him great enjoyment.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 阅读给他带来极大的享受。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Cooking has always been a small enjoyment of mine.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to experience happiness or pleasure from doing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 found 是 find 的过去式，great joy 作宾语，in creating… 为介词短语；整体表示过去持续的感觉。
vocab_pack.example_en: She finds joy in helping others.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她在帮助他人中找到快乐。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I found great joy in creating delicious meals from the beginning.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a number of similar events or things that happen one after another
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作主语 a series of accidents，谓语动词用单数 left；a series of 后接可数名词复数。
vocab_pack.example_en: A series of experiments was conducted to test the theory.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 进行了一系列实验来验证该理论。
vocab_pack.from_passage: However, a series of accidents, including a few unfortunate cuts, left me hesitant to cook.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone to feel uncertain or unwilling to do something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 使某人对做某事犹豫不决
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 left 是 leave 的过去式，me 是宾语，hesitant 是形容词作宾补，to cook 是不定式表示犹豫的内容。
vocab_pack.example_en: The bad experience left him hesitant to try again.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那次糟糕的经历让他对再次尝试犹豫不决。
vocab_pack.from_passage: left me hesitant to cook.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become or keep someone away from something or someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 distanced 是 distance 的过去式，oneself 对应 myself，from 后接 cooking（动名词作介词宾语）。
vocab_pack.example_en: She decided to distance herself from toxic relationships.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她决定远离那些有害的关系。
vocab_pack.from_passage: So I gradually distanced myself from cooking

vocab_pack.definition_en: to depend on someone or something for help or support
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 relying 是 rely 的现在分词，与 more on 构成短语，作状语修饰主句；表示「更多地依靠」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Students should not rely on their phones too much.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学生不应过度依赖手机。
vocab_pack.from_passage: relying more on my husband to cook or takeout.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make a choice to take a particular action
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 decided 是 decide 的过去式，to rediscover 是动词不定式作宾语，表示决定的内容。
vocab_pack.example_en: He decided to study abroad after graduation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他决定毕业后出国留学。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I decided to rediscover my love for cooking

vocab_pack.definition_en: to find, experience, or enjoy something again that you had lost or stopped doing
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中与 decided to 连用，不定式形式，表示「重新发现」；动词原形前加 re- 表示再次。
vocab_pack.example_en: Traveling helped her rediscover her passion for photography.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 旅行帮助她重新发现了对摄影的热爱。
vocab_pack.from_passage: decided to rediscover my love for cooking

vocab_pack.definition_en: causing a complete or major change in someone or something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 变革性的；有改造作用的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作表语，接在 it's been 之后（现在完成时），表示「一直是变革性的」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher's influence was transformative for the students.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那位老师的影响对学生来说是变革性的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: it's been transformative.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to start doing something again after a period of not doing it
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 getting 是 get 的动名词形式，作主语；back into the kitchen 表示「重新进入厨房」，比喻重新开始烹饪。
vocab_pack.example_en: It took him a while to get back into exercising regularly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他过了一段时间才重新开始规律锻炼。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Getting back into cooking wasn't easy.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to continue to exist, especially after other things have gone or been dealt with
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 remained 是系动词过去式，后无表语（此处作不及物动词），表示记忆「依然存在」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Despite the difficulties, her spirit remained strong.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 尽管困难重重，她的精神依然坚强。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Memories of past accidents with my hands remained

vocab_pack.definition_en: the feeling of being afraid of something or doing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 fear of 与动名词短语 injuring myself 连用，构成名词短语作主语；fear 为不可数名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her fear of flying prevented her from traveling abroad.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她对飞行的恐惧阻止了她出国旅行。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the fear of injuring myself again appeared.

vocab_pack.definition_en: the amount of money needed to pay for basic necessities such as food, housing, and transportation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作从句主语 the cost of living，谓语 continued to rise；为固定搭配，无冠词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The cost of living in big cities is rising rapidly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 大城市的生活成本正在迅速上涨。
vocab_pack.from_passage: as the cost of living continued to rise

vocab_pack.definition_en: to keep happening or doing something without stopping
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 continued 是 continue 的过去式，to rise 是不定式作宾语，表示「继续上涨」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The population continues to grow in many developing countries.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多发展中国家的人口继续增长。
vocab_pack.from_passage: continued to rise

vocab_pack.definition_en: able to continue at a certain level or last for a long time without causing harm
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作表语，wasn't sustainable 是过去时否定，表示「不能持续」。
vocab_pack.example_en: We need to find sustainable energy sources.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们需要寻找可持续的能源。
vocab_pack.from_passage: wasn't sustainable.

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a way that shows firm intention and effort to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作状语，修饰 stepped，表示「带着决心」；with + 抽象名词构成短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She faced the challenge with determination.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她坚定地面对挑战。
vocab_pack.from_passage: with determination

vocab_pack.definition_en: to enter a place or situation again after having been away from it
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 stepped 是 step 的过去式，back into 表示方向，the kitchen 是介词宾语；意为「重新走进厨房」。
vocab_pack.example_en: After a long break, she stepped back into the classroom as a teacher.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 经过长时间休息后，她以老师的身份重新走进了教室。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I stepped back into the kitchen.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to renew or strengthen someone's strong interest in something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 重新点燃某人对……的热情
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 refueled 是 refuel 的过去分词，构成现在完成时 has refueled，my passion for 是宾语加介词。
vocab_pack.example_en: Watching inspiring documentaries can refuel your passion for learning.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 观看鼓舞人心的纪录片可以重新点燃你的学习热情。
vocab_pack.from_passage: has truly refueled my passion for cooking

vocab_pack.definition_en: (of a film, book, etc.) to become available to the public
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 came out 是 come out 的过去式，表示电影「上映」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new album came out last month.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这张新专辑上个月发行了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: When the movie *Julie and Julia* came out

vocab_pack.definition_en: to begin to have a strong feeling of affection or strong interest in someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 fell in love with 是 fall in love with 的过去式，后接 cooking（动名词），表示过去爱上了烹饪。
vocab_pack.example_en: She fell in love with the city during her first visit.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她第一次访问时就爱上了这座城市。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I fell in love with cooking

vocab_pack.definition_en: to try to do something, especially something difficult
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 attempted 是 attempt 的过去式，在 never attempted 中表示过去从未尝试过。
vocab_pack.example_en: He attempted to solve the problem on his own.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他试图独自解决这个问题。
vocab_pack.from_passage: never attempted this classic French dish.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a task done for the pleasure or satisfaction it brings, not for money or reward
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 出于热爱而做的事；心甘情愿做的事
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作表语，It's certainly a labor of love，意为「这确实是一件出于热爱做的事」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Restoring the old house was a labor of love for her.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 修复那栋老房子对她来说是出于热爱的事。
vocab_pack.from_passage: It's certainly a labor of love

vocab_pack.definition_en: to need a large amount of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 requiring 是 require 的现在分词，与 a lot of 连用，引导后置定语修饰 a labor of love，表示「需要大量的时间、耐心……」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Writing a book requires a lot of time and effort.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 写书需要大量的时间和精力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: requiring a lot of time, patience, and attention to detail.

vocab_pack.definition_en: the careful and thorough consideration of all the small parts of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作 require 的宾语之一，与 time, patience 并列；attention to detail 为固定搭配，无冠词。
vocab_pack.example_en: Good engineering requires great attention to detail.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 好的工程需要对细节高度关注。
vocab_pack.from_passage: attention to detail

vocab_pack.definition_en: to add salt, pepper, herbs, or spices to food to improve its flavor
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 seasoning 是 season 的动名词，与 the beef with salt and pepper 组成动名词短语，作介词 From 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Season the chicken with garlic and rosemary before roasting.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 烤鸡前用大蒜和迷迭香调味。
vocab_pack.from_passage: From seasoning the beef with salt and pepper

vocab_pack.definition_en: to combine two or more substances so that they become one
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 mixing 是 mix 的动名词，与 it with wine 构成动名词短语，与 seasoning… 并列，作 from 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Mix the flour with water to form a dough.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 把面粉和水混合成面团。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to mixing it with wine

vocab_pack.definition_en: a feeling of pride and satisfaction from achieving something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作 give 的直接宾语，gave me a sense of accomplishment，意为「给了我一种成就感」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Finishing the marathon gave him a great sense of accomplishment.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 完成马拉松给了他极大的成就感。
vocab_pack.from_passage: gave me a sense of accomplishment

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make someone remember something they may have forgotten
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 reminding 是 remind 的现在分词，作状语，表示伴随结果；后接宾语 me，再接 why 从句。
vocab_pack.example_en: This song reminds me of my childhood.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这首歌让我想起了我的童年。
vocab_pack.from_passage: reminding me why I fell in love with cooking.

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to say that something is not necessary or required
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 doesn't have to be 是 do not have to 的第三人称单数形式，后接形容词 burden，表示「不必是负担」。
vocab_pack.example_en: You don't have to finish the work today.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你不必今天完成这项工作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Cooking doesn't have to be a burden

vocab_pack.definition_en: the expression of your own thoughts, feelings, or personality, especially through art, writing, or other creative activities
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作介词 of 的宾语，a form of self-expression，表示「一种自我表达的形式」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Art allows for powerful self-expression.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 艺术允许强有力的自我表达。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a form of self-expression.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a particular type or kind of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 a form of self-expression，表示「一种自我表达的形式」；form 为可数名词，前有不定冠词 a。
vocab_pack.example_en: Dance is a beautiful form of art.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 舞蹈是一种美丽的艺术形式。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a form of self-expression.

section_2_word_form.passage:
The term "Xuan paper" first appeared in On Famous Paintings Through the Ages, a book written by Tang Dynasty scholar Zhang Yanyuan, [56] he described Xuan paper as an ideal carrier for calligraphy and painting. Handmade Xuan paper from Jingxian county, East China's Anhui province, [57] as a gift to the imperial court then for its supreme quality.
During the Qing Dynasty Xuan paper reached its peak of [58] and quality. The traditional craft (工艺) of making Xuan paper is extremely [59] . The bark of sandalwood, a plant native to southern China, [60] through 108 procedures over the course of three years before it can transform into fine Xuan paper.
The flow of ink determines the output of Chinese art, and Xuan paper outshines others with its excellent ability [61] full play to ink. Different proportions (比例) of bark to straw during the paper-making process can create different canvases (画布) best suited [62] artistic expression in freehand ink paintings or calligraphy. The unique quality of Xuan paper is [63] valued in the world of Chinese calligraphy and painting.
Xuan paper is very resistant to the damage brought by time. It is this durability [64] has made the preservation of many valuable works from ancient China possible. The long history, unique craftsmanship, and high quality of Xuan paper have made it a [65] cultural heritage of China.

questions.explanation: 分析句子结构可知，逗号后是非限制性定语从句，先行词是 a book。从句完整不缺主宾，且在从句中作地点/方位状语（in the book），故用关系副词where（也可填in which，但设空为一词优先where）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(where)：语境句：This is the exact spot where the accident happened. 固定搭配：where to go, point where。其它用法：可作连词引导地点状语从句。

questions.explanation: 句意：手工宣纸在当时因其极高的品质“被列为”皇家贡品。主语 Xuan paper 与 list 之间是动宾关系，且时间状语 then 表明是过去的事，故填一般过去时的被动语态。
knowledge_points: 一般过去时的被动语态
questions.supplement: 正确形(was listed)：语境句：The building was listed as a national heritage site last year. 固定搭配：be listed as, list out。原词list其它变形：unlisted(adj.), listing(n.)。

questions.explanation: 介词 of 后应接名词，且由 and 可知需要与名词 quality 并列，popular 的名词形式是 popularity（受欢迎度/普及）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(popularity)：语境句：The band has gained huge popularity among teenagers. 固定搭配：gain popularity, popularity contest。原词popular其它变形：popularize(v.), popularly(adv.)。

questions.explanation: 系动词 is 后需接形容词作表语。demand意为“要求”，其形容词 demanding 意为“要求高的，费力的”，符合修饰传统工艺（craft）极难的语境。
questions.supplement: 正确形(demanding)：语境句：She has a very demanding schedule this week. 固定搭配：highly demanding, a demanding job。原词demand其它变形：demand(n./v.), undemanding(adj.)。

questions.explanation: 句意：檀树皮要“经历”108道工序。陈述工艺流程的一般事实，用一般现在时。主语 The bark 是不可数名词，谓语动词用第三人称单数goes。go through 为固定短语，意为“经历”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(goes)：语境句：The country goes through severe economic challenges. 固定搭配：go through, go ahead。原词go其它变形：went(v.过去式), gone(v.过去分词)。

questions.explanation: 名词 ability 后常跟动词不定式作后置定语，即 ability to do sth.。give full play to 意为“充分发挥”。
knowledge_points: 动词不定式作后置定语
questions.supplement: 正确形(to give)：语境句：She has the ability to give clear and concise explanations. 固定搭配：ability to do, give full play to。原词give其它变形：gave(v.过去式), given(v.过去分词)。

questions.explanation: 固定搭配 be suited for/to 意为“适合于...”，此处 suited 为过去分词作后置定语，修饰 canvases，应填介词 for 或 to。
questions.supplement: 正确形(for / to)：语境句：This mild climate is perfectly suited for growing grapes. 固定搭配：be suited for, be suited to。

questions.explanation: 空处修饰后面的动词（过去分词）valued，需用副词形式。high 的副词 highly 意为“高度地，极度地”，highly valued 即“被高度重视/评价”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(highly)：语境句：Her creative designs are highly valued by the fashion industry. 固定搭配：highly valued, speak highly of。原词high其它变形：highness(n.), higher(adj.)。

questions.explanation: 考查强调句型。句子结构为 It is + 被强调部分 + that/who ...。本句强调的是主语 this durability（正是这种耐久性），且为事物，故用 that。
questions.supplement: 正确形(that)：语境句：It is his courage that makes him a true hero. 固定搭配：It is... that..., so... that...。其它用法：指代词、从句引导词等。

questions.explanation: 空处修饰名词短语 cultural heritage（文化遗产），需要形容词。treasure的过去分词 treasured 已形容词化，意为“珍贵的，受珍视的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(treasured)：语境句：These letters are among my most treasured possessions. 固定搭配：treasured memory, national treasure。原词treasure其它变形：treasure(n./v.), treasury(n.), treasurer(n.)。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a word or phrase used to describe a thing or to express a concept
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：在句中作主语，单数形式，前面有定冠词the，表示特指“Xuan paper”这个术语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The term 'globalization' is widely used in economics.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 术语“全球化”在经济学中被广泛使用。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The term "Xuan paper" first appeared

vocab_pack.definition_en: to come into sight; to be published or shown
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为一般过去时，主动语态，表示“首次出现”这一过去的动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: The first mention of papermaking appeared in ancient Chinese records.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 造纸术的首次提及出现在中国古代记载中。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The term "Xuan paper" first appeared in On Famous Paintings Through the Ages

vocab_pack.definition_en: to say that someone or something has a particular quality or is a particular thing
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为一般过去时主动语态，described为过去式，后接宾语Xuan paper和as短语，表示“将宣纸描述为……”的固定搭配。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many critics describe her novel as a masterpiece of modern literature.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多评论家将她的这部小说描述为现代文学的杰作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: where he described Xuan paper as an ideal carrier for calligraphy and painting

vocab_pack.definition_en: a perfect medium or vehicle that conveys or holds something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 理想的载体；完美的媒介
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：在句中作介词as的宾语，ideal为形容词修饰carrier，carrier为可数名词单数，前面有不定冠词an。
vocab_pack.example_en: Silk was considered an ideal carrier for ancient Chinese paintings.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 丝绸被认为是古代中国绘画的理想载体。
vocab_pack.from_passage: described Xuan paper as an ideal carrier for calligraphy and painting

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be officially included in a list with a particular status
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 被列为；被列入（某种名单/类别）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为一般过去时被动语态，was listed as中listed是过去分词，表示“被列为……”，主语Handmade Xuan paper是单数。
vocab_pack.example_en: The Great Wall was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1987.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 长城于1987年被列为联合国教科文组织世界遗产。
vocab_pack.from_passage: was listed as a gift to the imperial court then

vocab_pack.definition_en: the highest or most excellent standard of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中作介词for的宾语，supreme为形容词修饰quality，quality为不可数名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: This brand is known for its supreme quality and durability.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个品牌以其卓越的品质和耐用性而闻名。
vocab_pack.from_passage: for its supreme quality

vocab_pack.definition_en: to reach the highest point of development, success, or popularity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为一般过去时主动语态，reached是过去式，its peak指代Xuan paper的顶峰，物主代词its与主语一致。
vocab_pack.example_en: The athlete's career reached its peak when she won an Olympic gold medal.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位运动员的职业生涯在她赢得奥运金牌时达到顶峰。
vocab_pack.from_passage: During the Qing Dynasty Xuan paper reached its peak of popularity and quality

vocab_pack.definition_en: requiring a lot of skill, effort, or patience
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 要求高的；费力的；苛刻的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中作表语，与is构成系表结构，形容词表示主语The traditional craft的性质特征。
vocab_pack.example_en: The training for a marathon is extremely demanding both physically and mentally.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 马拉松训练对身体和精神都有极高的要求。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The traditional craft of making Xuan paper is extremely demanding

vocab_pack.definition_en: to experience or undergo a process or series of steps
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 经历；经过（一系列步骤或程序）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为一般现在时主动语态，主语The bark为单数，谓语用goes through（第三人称单数形式），表示“经历108道工序”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Every applicant must go through a rigorous interview process.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 每位申请者都必须经过严格的面试流程。
vocab_pack.from_passage: goes through 108 procedures over the course of three years

vocab_pack.definition_en: during the period of time that something continues
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：介词短语，在句中作时间状语，修饰其前的动词短语，表示“在三年的时间里”持续进行。
vocab_pack.example_en: The project was completed over the course of six months.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该项目在六个月内完成。
vocab_pack.from_passage: over the course of three years

vocab_pack.definition_en: to change completely into something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为动词原形，与情态动词can构成谓语，表示树皮能够“转化成”优质宣纸。
vocab_pack.example_en: Caterpillars transform into butterflies through metamorphosis.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 毛毛虫通过变态发育变成蝴蝶。
vocab_pack.from_passage: before it can transform into fine Xuan paper

vocab_pack.definition_en: the continuous movement of a liquid, air, or electricity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中作主语的中心词，与介词of构成短语the flow of ink，为不可数名词，谓语用单数determines。
vocab_pack.example_en: The flow of water in the river is controlled by a dam.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 河中水流由大坝控制。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The flow of ink determines the output of Chinese art

vocab_pack.definition_en: to control or influence something directly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为一般现在时，主语The flow of ink是单数，谓语用第三人称单数形式determines，表示“决定”中国艺术作品的输出效果。
vocab_pack.example_en: The quality of raw materials determines the final product's value.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 原材料的质量决定了最终产品的价值。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The flow of ink determines the output of Chinese art

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be much better than someone or something; to surpass
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 胜过；比……更出色；使……相形见绌
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为一般现在时主动语态，主语Xuan paper是单数，谓语用outshines（第三人称单数形式），宾语others，表示宣纸“胜过”其他纸张。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her performance outshone all the other contestants.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的表演使其他所有参赛者都黯然失色。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Xuan paper outshines others with its excellent ability

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make something fully effective or to allow full expression of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为动词不定式to give full play to中的核心部分，give是原形，后接介词to，整体作后置定语修饰ability，表示“充分发挥墨水效果的能力”。
vocab_pack.example_en: A good teacher should give full play to students' creativity.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 好老师应该充分发挥学生的创造力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: its excellent ability to give full play to ink

vocab_pack.definition_en: the ratio or comparative relationship between one part and another
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中主语为Different proportions，复数形式，proportion of A to B表示A对B的比例，to引出比较对象。
vocab_pack.example_en: The proportion of water to cement is critical in concrete mixing.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 水与水泥的比例在混凝土搅拌中至关重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Different proportions of bark to straw during the paper-making process

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be suitable or appropriate for a particular purpose or situation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为过去分词短语作定语，修饰canvases，best是副词修饰suited，for/to两个介词均可，表示“最适合于大写意绘画或书法艺术表现”。
vocab_pack.example_en: This software is well suited for handling large datasets.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这款软件非常适合处理大型数据集。
vocab_pack.from_passage: best suited for / to artistic expression in freehand ink paintings or calligraphy

vocab_pack.definition_en: a distinctive or one-of-a-kind characteristic
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 独特品质；独一无二的特性
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中作主语的中心词，unique为形容词修饰quality，quality为不可数名词，谓语用is valued，表示“独特的品质被高度评价”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The unique quality of handmade products attracts many consumers.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 手工制品的独特品质吸引了许多消费者。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The unique quality of Xuan paper is highly valued

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be regarded with great respect or appreciation
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 被高度重视；被高度评价
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为一般现在时被动语态，is valued，highly为副词修饰valued，表示“在中国书法和绘画界被高度评价”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Original paintings by this artist are highly valued by collectors.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位艺术家的原创画作受到收藏家的高度重视。
vocab_pack.from_passage: is highly valued in the world of Chinese calligraphy and painting

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be not easily damaged, affected, or changed by something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 抵抗……的；对……有抵抗力的；不易受……损害的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为系表结构，resistant为形容词，与is构成谓语，very修饰resistant，后接介词to表示“对时间带来的损害具有很强的抵抗力”。
vocab_pack.example_en: This material is highly resistant to high temperatures.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这种材料非常耐高温。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Xuan paper is very resistant to the damage brought by time

vocab_pack.definition_en: the ability to withstand wear, pressure, or damage
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中作表语，前面有this指示代词，即it is this durability，强调主语（这种耐久性），表示正是这种耐久性使古代作品的保存成为可能。
vocab_pack.example_en: The durability of concrete makes it an ideal building material.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 混凝土的耐久性使其成为理想的建筑材料。
vocab_pack.from_passage: It is this durability that has made the preservation of many valuable works from ancient China possible

vocab_pack.definition_en: the act of keeping something in its original state or in good condition
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中作宾语，与made构成make + 宾语 + possible结构，即made the preservation possible，preservation为不可数名词，后接of短语说明保存的对象。
vocab_pack.example_en: The preservation of historical documents requires a controlled environment.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 历史文献的保存需要受控的环境。
vocab_pack.from_passage: made the preservation of many valuable works from ancient China possible

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: made the preservation of many valuable works from ancient China possible
vocab_pack.definition_en: to enable something to happen or exist
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为现在完成时主动语态，has made是谓语，宾语是the preservation...，possible是宾补，构成make + 宾语 + 形容词的复合结构，表示“使……的保存成为可能”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Technology has made remote work possible for millions of people.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 技术使数百万人能够远程工作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: It is this durability that has made the preservation of many valuable works from ancient China possible

vocab_pack.definition_en: a period of time lasting many years in the past
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中与unique craftsmanship和high quality并列作主语，long为形容词修饰history，history为不可数名词，表示“悠久的历史”是使宣纸成为文化瑰宝的因素之一。
vocab_pack.example_en: The city has a long history dating back over 2,000 years.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座城市有超过2000年的悠久历史。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The long history, unique craftsmanship, and high quality of Xuan paper

vocab_pack.definition_en: distinctive skill and quality in making things by hand
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 独特的工艺；独到的技艺
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中作主语之一，unique为形容词，craftsmanship为不可数名词，表示“独特的工艺”是宣纸成为文化遗产的原因之一。
vocab_pack.example_en: The furniture is admired for its unique craftsmanship and design.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这件家具因其独特的工艺和设计而受到赞赏。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The long history, unique craftsmanship, and high quality of Xuan paper

vocab_pack.definition_en: something valuable and respected that is passed down from previous generations as part of a culture
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中作宾语补足语？实际是made it ... heritage，即make + it + 名词短语，it指代Xuan paper，treasured为过去分词作形容词，heritage为可数名词单数，前面有不定冠词a。
vocab_pack.example_en: Traditional festivals are a treasured cultural heritage of many nations.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 传统节日是许多国家的珍贵文化遗产。
vocab_pack.from_passage: have made it a treasured cultural heritage of China

vocab_pack.definition_en: the art of writing beautifully and the art of creating visual images
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：在句中多次出现，如for calligraphy and painting（作介词宾语）和in the world of Chinese calligraphy and painting（作介词宾语），为两个并列不可数名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The museum has a fine collection of Chinese calligraphy and painting.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家博物馆收藏了精美的中国书法和绘画。
vocab_pack.from_passage: an ideal carrier for calligraphy and painting

vocab_pack.definition_en: made by hand, not by machine
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中作定语修饰Xuan paper，位于句首大写，表示“手工制作的宣纸”。
vocab_pack.example_en: She prefers handmade pottery because of its unique texture.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她更喜欢手工制作的陶器，因为它独特的质地。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Handmade Xuan paper from Jingxian county

vocab_pack.definition_en: for the first time; before any others
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中作状语，修饰谓语appeared，表示“首次出现”，位于动词之前。
vocab_pack.example_en: The word first appeared in English in the 17th century.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个词在17世纪首次出现在英语中。
vocab_pack.from_passage: first appeared in On Famous Paintings Through the Ages

vocab_pack.definition_en: the act of communicating ideas, feelings, or creativity through art
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中作介词to的宾语，artistic为形容词修饰expression，expression为不可数名词，表示“适合/适于艺术表现”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The school encourages artistic expression through music, painting, and drama.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学校通过音乐、绘画和戏剧鼓励艺术表达。
vocab_pack.from_passage: suited for / to artistic expression in freehand ink paintings or calligraphy
